heroHeadline: Day 81: FGR Opens 'CIAgate' Criminal Investigation of Chihuahua Fiscalía — Possible Treason Charges; El Checo (CJNG Tecate) Arrested; El Sapo Hunt Day 81; 28 Days to FIFA World Cup
heroSubtitle: Day 81 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CIAGATE CRIMINAL ESCALATION (May 13–14, 2026): Mexico's FGR opened two formal investigation lines against Chihuahua's state attorney general's office for 'invasión de competencia federal' in the April 17–18 CIA-linked Morelos narcolaboratorio operation. Key findings: FGR never received chain of custody for the lab (which contained 55,000 liters of liquid precursors, 50+ tons of solids, ~2,000 liters of meth); 7 foreign-national/CIA-affiliated agents declined to testify; Chihuahua Strategic Operations Fiscal Guillermo Arturo Zuany Portillo resigned. The FGR's second investigation line examines possible 'actos de traición a la patria' (treason) — El Universal's 'CIAgate' designation now applicable. Sheinbaum: 'The FGR will have the last word.' La Razón (May 14): FGR formally added jurisdictional invasion to the national security crimes file. CNN stood by its CIA Ground Branch lethal operations report (Washington Post, May 13) despite categorical denials from García Harfuch and CIA spokesperson ('false and salacious'). EL CHECO ARRESTED (May 13): Sergio Serrano 'El Checo,' 51, CJNG Tecate regional leader and member of 'Los Volteados' (Sinaloa Cartel defectors who joined CJNG December 2025), arrested after 30km+ high-speed pursuit near Rancho Viejo, Baja California. Cumulative HVT count reaches 47+. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 81: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement priority (since May 3). POST-EL CHUCKY MANZANILLO VOID (Day 5): Port of Manzanillo CJNG plaza command in transition — no successor identified. ACLED ASSESSMENT (May 12) stands: zero CJNG organizational fracture, 'tactical containment,' Michoacán alliance reinforcement with Los Viagras. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 81: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27, vinculado a proceso May 4), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. QUINTUPLE BILATERAL PRESSURE TRACK — MAXIMUM STRESS: (1) CIA Chihuahua CIAgate + FGR criminal investigation; (2) DOJ SDNY indictment of Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya + 9 officials ('temporary leave' since May 2); (3) Sheinbaum's 'irrefutable proof' extradition standard (May 6); (4) U.S. State Dept review of all 53 Mexican consulates; (5) ongoing CJNG interdiction framework. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader, El País April 6) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). PLAN KUKULKAN — 28 DAYS: 28 days to FIFA World Cup 2026 June 11 opening match. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium) hosts 4 group-stage matches; 130,000-person nationwide security deployment continues.
